name: drag-snap-grid
title: Drag Snap Grid
description: Draggable tiles that snap to the nearest grid cell on release with a spring settle — occupancy is enforced (a cell holds one tile), and the displaced tile animates to the freed cell, making the grid itself the state machine.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Mosaic
Density: Dense
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Kinetic
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Drag Snap Arrange: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
